name: list_files
description: List files and folders inside the workspace.

name: read_file
description: Read a text file from the workspace. Returns at most the first 100,000 characters; use read_lines for big files.

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a text file in the workspace. Missing folders are created.

name: make_dir
description: Create a folder inside the workspace.

name: create_web_project
description: Create projects/<name> with index.html, style.css and script.js. Link the CSS and JS from index.html with relative paths. The dashboard can preview it.

name: web_search
description: Search the web and return titles, links and snippets.

name: scrape_page
description: Fetch a public web page and return its readable text. Pages that need a login are not supported.

name: download_file
description: Download a public file into downloads/. Downloads need the user's approval in the dashboard unless the connection is trusted (approved downloads up to 300 MB): call once to request it, then call again with the approval_id the tool returns.

name: wait_approval
description: Hold the call open until every listed approval is approved, then reply Accepted!. approval_ids is a comma-separated list of request ids. Returns at once if any request is denied or expired. Waits at most timeout_s seconds (max 45). If the reply says still waiting, call it again with the same ids.

name: multi_run
description: Run up to 10 tool calls at once in parallel. calls is a JSON list such as [{"tool": "read_file", "arguments": {"path": "notes.txt"}}]. Results come back in the same order. Approval-gated tools still need their own approval_id. multi_run cannot call itself.

name: read_lines
description: Read a range of lines from a workspace text file. start is the first line number (1 is the first line). count is how many lines to read, up to 1000. Use this to read big files in parts.

name: append_file
description: Add text to the end of a workspace file. Creates the file if it does not exist.

name: move_file
description: Rename or move a file or folder inside the workspace. Refuses to overwrite anything that already exists.

name: search_files
description: Search for text inside workspace files under a folder. Returns file paths and line numbers, up to 100 matches. Skips files over 2 MB and non-text files.

name: get_activity
description: Show the most recent activity log entries: tool calls, download requests and approvals. limit is how many entries to show, up to 200.

name: build_icon_library
description: Build the css.gg library in library/css-gg: all-icons.css (every icon's CSS in one file) and icon-index.txt (name, tags and class for each icon). Run this after the icon pack is downloaded.

name: search_icons
description: Search the css.gg icon pack by name or tag. Returns the name, tags and class name for each match, up to 200.

name: get_icon
description: Return one css.gg icon's HTML, CSS and SVG. The HTML needs the CSS, so link library/css-gg/all-icons.css or paste the CSS into the page.

name: list_projects
description: List the web projects in projects/ and where each one previews on the dashboard.

name: list_tree
description: List files and folders inside a workspace folder, including subfolders. Shows up to 1000 entries.

name: copy_file
description: Copy a file inside the workspace. Refuses to overwrite an existing file.

name: file_info
description: Show a file's or folder's type, size and last-modified time.

name: delete_file
description: Delete one file in the workspace (not folders). The user must approve it in the dashboard first. Call once without approval_id to request approval, then call again with the same path and the approval_id the tool returns.

name: make_archive
description: Zip a workspace folder into downloads/<name>.zip. Zip a subfolder, not the whole workspace or downloads. Refuses folders over 300 MB.

name: extract_zip
description: Unzip a .zip file in the workspace into a folder (default: the zip's own folder). Refuses to overwrite existing files, paths that escape the folder, archives with more than 5000 files, or archives that expand past 300 MB.

name: untar_archive
description: Unpack a .tgz or .tar.gz archive in the workspace into a folder (default: the archive's name).

name: list_archive
description: List what is inside a .zip or .tgz archive in the workspace without unpacking it.

name: file_hash
description: Compute a file's checksum. algo can be sha256, sha1 or md5.

name: disk_usage
description: Show the total size of each item in a workspace folder, largest first.

name: find_large_files
description: Find workspace files at least min_mb megabytes in size, largest first.

name: count_lines
description: Count the lines in a workspace file.

name: library_manifest
description: List every file under a folder with its size, and the total.

name: write_library_index
description: Save the file list and total size of a folder as INDEX.md inside that folder.

name: validate_json
description: Check whether a workspace file contains valid JSON.

name: pretty_json
description: Return a workspace JSON file pretty-printed. Does not change the file.

name: csv_preview
description: Show the first rows of a CSV file in the workspace.

name: base64_encode
description: Return a small workspace file (up to 2 MB) as base64 text.

name: text_replace
description: Replace every occurrence of some text in one workspace file.

name: tail_file
description: Show the last lines of a workspace file, useful for logs.

name: find_duplicates
description: Find workspace files with identical content under a folder.

name: check_url
description: Check whether a public web address responds, and return its HTTP status.

name: extension_summary
description: Count files by extension under a workspace folder, most common first.

name: now_utc
description: Return the current time in UTC (ISO format).

name: word_count
description: Count the words in a workspace text file.

name: json_keys
description: List the top-level keys of a workspace JSON object.

name: project_files
description: List every file in a project folder with its size.

name: project_read
description: Read one file from a project folder (for example index.html or style.css). Returns up to 100,000 characters.

name: project_write
description: Create or overwrite one file in a project folder. Use this to edit index.html, style.css or script.js.

name: project_outline
description: List the headings (h1 to h6) in a project's index.html, in order.

name: project_links
description: List every href and src in a project's index.html.

name: project_check_links
description: Check that every local file the project's index.html points to exists inside the project.

name: project_colors
description: List the hex colors used in a project's HTML and CSS, most used first.

name: project_fonts
description: List the font-family values used in a project's HTML and CSS.

name: project_scripts
description: List the script files a project loads and whether each one exists.

name: project_size
description: Show how many files a project has and their total size.

name: project_title
description: Show the page title from a project's index.html.

name: project_meta
description: List the meta tags in a project's index.html.

name: project_images
description: List the images in a project's index.html and whether each has alt text.

name: project_accessibility
description: Run basic accessibility checks on a project's index.html: lang, alt text, button text, labels.

name: project_seo
description: Run basic SEO checks on a project's index.html: title length, description, heading count.

name: project_duplicate_ids
description: Find id attributes used more than once in a project's index.html.

name: project_js_functions
description: List the named functions and arrow-function constants in a project's script.js.

name: project_clone
description: Copy a project into a new project folder with a new name. Refuses if the new name already exists.

name: project_rename
description: Rename a project folder. Refuses if the new name already exists. Preview links change to the new name.

name: project_snapshot
description: Save a timestamped copy of a project into backups/ before you change it.

name: project_zip
description: Zip a whole project into downloads/<name>-project.zip for sharing.

name: project_minify_css
description: Write style.min.css in a project: a smaller copy of style.css with comments and spaces removed.

name: project_word_count
description: Count the visible words in a project's index.html (scripts and styles excluded).

name: site_headers
description: Show the HTTP response headers a public site sends.

name: site_redirects
description: Show the redirect chain for a public URL and the final address.

name: site_title
description: Show the page title of a public URL.

name: site_meta
description: List the meta tags of a public page.

name: site_open_graph
description: List the Open Graph tags (og:*) of a public page, used for link previews.

name: site_links
description: List the links on a public page, with internal and external counts. Shows up to 100 links.

name: site_broken_links
description: Check up to 30 internal links on a public page and report the ones that fail (HTTP 400 or more).

name: site_images
description: List the images on a public page, and which ones have no alt text. Shows up to 100.

name: site_scripts
description: List the script files a public page loads.

name: site_stylesheets
description: List the stylesheets a public page loads.

name: site_forms
description: List the forms on a public page with their method, action and fields.

name: site_tech_hints
description: Guess which common frameworks and libraries a public page uses, from its HTML.

name: site_security_headers
description: Check whether a public site sends the common security headers (CSP, HSTS, and others).

name: site_cookies
description: List the cookies a public site sets on the first visit (names only).

name: site_robots
description: Read the robots.txt file of a public site (first 3000 characters).

name: site_sitemap
description: Read the sitemap.xml of a public site and count the URLs in it (first 100 shown).

name: site_favicon
description: Find the favicon of a public site (from the page's link tags, or /favicon.ico).

name: site_json_ld
description: Show the structured data (JSON-LD) a public page declares, for search engines.

name: site_accessibility
description: Run basic accessibility checks on a public page: lang, alt text, button text, labels.

name: site_mixed_content
description: On an https page, list any resources loaded over insecure http.

name: site_text_length
description: Count the visible words on a public page (scripts and styles excluded).

name: site_load_time
description: Measure how long a public page takes to download, its status and its size.

name: site_dns
description: Show the IP addresses a public site's host name resolves to.

name: site_ssl_expiry
description: Show when a public site's HTTPS certificate expires.

name: site_colors
description: List the hex colors used in a public page's HTML and inline styles, most used first.

name: site_fonts
description: List the font-family values used in a public page's HTML and inline styles.

name: site_crawl
description: Crawl a public site from one page, following links on the same host. Lists each page's title. max_pages is up to 20.

name: browser_dump
description: Load a public page in headless Chromium so its JavaScript runs, then return the readable text. Needs Chromium (pkg install chromium).

name: browser_batch
description: Take screenshots of up to 5 public pages in one go. urls is one address per line. Saves to screenshots/<prefix>-1.png and so on. Needs Chromium.

name: browser_get_html
description: Return the rendered HTML of a public page after its JavaScript runs. Needs Chromium.

name: browser_get_links
description: List every link on a rendered public page, with its text and full target address. Needs Chromium.

name: browser_get_forms
description: List the forms on a rendered public page with method, action and field names. Does not submit anything. Needs Chromium.

name: browser_list_assets
description: List the stylesheets, scripts, images and other files a rendered public page loads, with full addresses. Needs Chromium.

name: browser_download_asset
description: Save one asset into downloads/. Files up to 100 MB save automatically. Larger files need the dashboard approval.

name: browser_fullpage_screenshot
description: Take one tall screenshot of a whole public page. Saves to screenshots/<name>.png. Height 800 to 12000. Needs Chromium.

name: capture_site_pages
description: Save rendered HTML, markdown text and a screenshot for up to 5 public pages (one address per line) into projects/experimental/<site>/. Needs Chromium.

name: capture_site_summary
description: Write summary.md for a captured site: every file saved under projects/experimental/<site>/ with its size.

name: browser_open_session
description: Open a browser session on a public page that keeps cookies and page state between steps. Returns a session id. Needs Playwright.

name: browser_list_sessions
description: List open browser sessions and the address each one is on.

name: browser_close_session
description: Close a browser session and forget its cookies and state.

name: browser_set_viewport
description: Change the width and height of a browser session, for mobile or desktop captures.

name: browser_click
description: Click an element by its visible text or a CSS selector. Clicks that look like login, submit, accept, pay or approve need the user's approval: call once without approval_id to request it, then call again with the approval_id the tool returns after the user approves it in the dashboard.

name: browser_type
description: Type text into a field by CSS selector or label text. Password fields need the user's approval: call once to request it, then call again with the approval_id the tool returns after the user approves it in the dashboard.

name: browser_press_key
description: Press a key in the page, for example Enter, Escape, Tab or ArrowDown.

name: browser_scroll
description: Scroll the page down by amount pixels (negative scrolls up), or scroll an element into view if target is given.

name: browser_hover
description: Hover over an element by CSS selector or visible text, for menus that open on hover.

name: browser_select_option
description: Choose an option in a dropdown by CSS selector, given its value or visible label.

name: browser_wait_for
description: Wait until a text or CSS selector appears on the page, up to timeout_s seconds.

name: browser_get_text
description: Return the visible text of the current page in a session.

name: browser_get_console
description: Return the browser console messages collected in a session, for debugging.

name: browser_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the current view in a session. Saves to screenshots/<name>.png.

name: browser_scroll_capture
description: Scroll the current page in a session one screen at a time and save one screenshot per screen to screenshots/<name>-N.png. Up to 12 frames.

name: browser_network_log
description: List the requests a session loaded, with status code, method and address. No response bodies.

name: browser_storage_names
description: List localStorage keys, sessionStorage keys and cookie names in a session. Values are never shown.

name: web_session_open
description: Open a web session on a public page. Sessions keep cookies between steps. Returns a session id, the title and the address.

name: web_session_get
description: Go to another page in a web session. A relative address is taken from the current page. Returns the title and the address.

name: web_session_links
description: List the links on the current page of a web session, as full addresses. Shows up to 100.

name: web_session_forms
description: List the forms on the current page of a web session, with their index, method, action and fields.

name: web_session_submit
description: Submit a form on the current page of a web session. fields is a JSON object of field names and values. The user must approve each submission in the dashboard first: call once without approval_id, then call again with the same arguments and the approval_id the tool returns.

name: web_session_close
description: Close a web session and forget its cookies.

name: web_sessions
description: List the open web sessions and the address each one is on.

name: screenshot_page
description: Take a PNG screenshot of a public page or a dashboard preview link, using Chromium if installed (pkg install chromium). Saves to screenshots/<name>.png.

name: view_image
description: Show a PNG from the workspace as an image so Claude can see it. Use the path screenshot_page saved, e.g. screenshots/<name>.png.

name: scroll_capture
description: Walk a page section by section and return one settled screenshot per section (a frame-by-frame scroll, not a video). anchors is a comma list of section ids, e.g. top,house,rooms,day,tides,letters,footer.

name: screenshot_part
description: Screenshot one part of a page: jump to a section id (e.g. house, rooms, day, tides, letters, footer; empty for the top), wait delay_ms so animations can finish, then return the image.

name: web_to_pdf
description: Save a web page or dashboard preview as a PDF in pdfs/<name>.pdf, after waiting delay_ms so animations can finish. Uses Chromium (pkg install chromium).

name: check_html_basics
description: Check a project's index.html for doctype, lang, title, viewport, meta description and exactly one h1.

name: check_local_links
description: List the local files a project's index.html points to (href, src, url()) and report any that are missing.

name: check_css_braces
description: Check a project's CSS file for unbalanced { } braces and unclosed comments.

name: check_js_syntax
description: Check a project's JavaScript file for syntax errors using node (install in Termux with: pkg install nodejs).

name: check_fonts_embedded
description: Check a project's @font-face rules: each font must be embedded as a data URI or point to a file that exists.

name: check_reduced_motion
description: Check that a project's index.html (including any inlined CSS) has a prefers-reduced-motion rule.

name: check_seo_tags
description: Check a project's index.html for Open Graph and Twitter tags, a canonical link and a favicon.

name: check_image_alt
description: Check that every in a project's index.html has alt text, and every role=img element has an aria-label.

name: check_button_labels
description: Check that every <button> in a project's index.html has visible text or an aria-label.

name: check_project_size
description: Report a project's total size and flag it if it is over the 16 MB page limit or has a file over 2 MB.

name: video_info
description: Report a video's duration, size, dimensions, frame rate and whether it has audio (uses ffprobe).

name: video_trim
description: Cut a video from start_s to end_s (seconds) into videos/<name>.mp4. Use end_s 0 for the end of the video.

name: video_speed
description: Speed a video up (factor above 1) or slow it down (factor below 1) into videos/<name>.mp4. Drops the audio.

name: video_mute
description: Remove the audio track from a video into videos/<name>.mp4, keeping the picture as it is.

name: video_concat
description: Join several videos (comma-separated workspace paths, in order) into videos/<name>.mp4. Videos should share a size and frame rate.

name: video_frames
description: Grab still frames from a video every every_s seconds (up to max_frames) into videos/<name>-frames/ and return them as images.

name: video_frame_at
description: Save one still frame at at_s seconds into videos/<name>.png and return it as an image.

name: video_gif
description: Make an animated GIF from part of a video into videos/<name>.gif.

name: video_from_frames
description: Build an MP4 video from the PNG images in a workspace folder (sorted by name), saved as videos/<name>.mp4.

name: video_slideshow
description: Make a video from images, each shown for its own time. slides is a comma list of path:seconds, e.g. downloads/a.jpg:3,photos/b.png:4.5. Optional music is an audio file (mp3, m4a, wav): it loops if needed, fits the video length and fades out at the end. Saved to videos/<name>.mp4.

name: markdown_preview
description: Turn a workspace Markdown file into a styled HTML page and return its dashboard preview link. Saves to previews/.

name: run_python
description: Run Python code in the workspace folder. The user must approve the exact code in the dashboard first. Call once without approval_id to request approval, then call again with the same code and the approval_id. Output is capped at 20,000 characters and the run stops after 60 seconds.

name: approval_request
description: Ask the user to approve something in the dashboard before you go on. what is a short label; detail is shown under it. Returns the request id.

name: approval_status
description: Show the status of one approval request: pending, approved, denied, used, cancelled or expired.

name: list_approvals
description: List approval requests, newest first. status filters to one state such as pending. limit caps the rows (max 100).

name: cancel_approval
description: Cancel a request that is still pending, so it can no longer be approved.

name: approval_cleanup
description: Delete approval records older than days (default 7). Pending requests are always kept.

name: approval_export
description: Save every approval record to a JSON file in the workspace, for your records.

name: approval_batch_add
description: Add an approval request to a named batch, so the user can approve several things together. Batch names use letters, numbers, - and _.

name: approval_batch_submit
description: Mark a batch ready for the user, who approves its requests together in the dashboard. Lists what is in it.

name: approval_batch_release
description: Check a batch. If every request in it is approved, reply Accepted! with the ids. Otherwise list what is still open.

name: tts_generate
description: Turn text into a WAV file in audio/<name>.wav using espeak (install in Termux with: pkg install espeak).

name: audio_info
description: Report an audio file's duration, codec, sample rate and channels (uses ffprobe).

name: audio_convert
description: Convert an audio file to wav, mp3 or ogg into audio/<name>.<format>.

name: audio_trim
description: Cut an audio file from start_s to end_s (seconds) into audio/<name>.mp3. Use end_s 0 for the end.

name: audio_volume
description: Make an audio file louder (factor above 1) or quieter (factor below 1) into audio/<name>.mp3.

name: image_info
description: Report an image's width, height and format (PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP) using ffprobe.

name: image_resize
description: Scale an image to a set width (height follows the ratio) into images/<name> in the same format.

name: image_convert
description: Convert an image between png, jpg and webp into images/<name>.<format>.

name: diff_files
description: Show what changed between two workspace text files as a unified diff (first max_lines lines).

name: backup_file
description: Save a timestamped copy of a workspace file into backups/ before you change it.

name: csv_to_json
description: Convert a CSV file with a header row into a JSON array saved as data/<name>.json.

name: json_to_csv
description: Convert a JSON array of objects into a CSV file saved as data/<name>.csv.

name: word_frequency
description: List the most common words in a workspace text file, with counts (common stop words removed).

name: project_preview_link
description: Return the full dashboard preview link for a file in a project, e.g. index.html.

name: project_check_all
description: Run the HTML, local link, CSS, JavaScript, reduced-motion and image-alt checks on a project in one report.

name: color_contrast
description: Calculate the WCAG contrast ratio between two hex colors (e.g. #1a1a1a and #fff) and check the AA rules for text.

name: log_activity
description: Add a row to activity.md with the current UTC time, action, tool, target and result. Earlier rows are never changed.

name: activity_summary
description: Count how many times each tool name appears in activity.md, most used first.

name: system_status
description: Show free disk space in the workspace and which helper programs are installed (ffmpeg, ffprobe, espeak, chromium, node, ngrok).

name: tool_list
description: List every registered tool name and the total count.

name: phone_torch
description: Turn the phone's flashlight on or off (Termux:API).

name: phone_notify
description: Send a notification on the phone with a title and text. Reuse a notification_id to replace an earlier one.

name: phone_notify_remove
description: Remove a notification that was sent with the given notification_id.

name: phone_toast
description: Show a pop-up message on the phone screen (toast). short makes it display briefly.

name: phone_vibrate
description: Vibrate the phone for a number of seconds, from 0.1 to 10.

name: phone_brightness
description: Set the screen brightness, from 0 to 255.

name: phone_volume
description: Set the volume of one stream: alarm, call, music, notification, ring or system.

name: phone_battery
description: Report the battery level, charging state and temperature (Termux:API).

name: phone_wifi
description: Report the current Wi-Fi connection: network name, signal strength and IP address (Termux:API).

name: phone_sensor
description: List the phone's sensors when name is empty, or take one reading from a sensor, for example accelerometer.

name: phone_audio_info
description: Show the phone's audio status: volume levels and active audio streams (Termux:API).

name: phone_speak
description: Speak text out loud on the phone with its text-to-speech voice.

name: phone_open_url
description: Open a web link (http or https only) in the phone's browser. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_media
description: Play or stop audio on the phone. action is play (with a file path in the workspace) or stop.

name: phone_clipboard_set
description: Copy text to the phone's clipboard. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_sms_send
description: Send a text message (SMS). Needs the user's approval in the dashboard first. Call once without approval_id to request it, then again with the same arguments and the approval_id it returns.

name: phone_sms_list
description: Read recent text messages from a box (inbox, sent, draft). Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_call
description: Place a phone call. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_call_log
description: Read the recent call log. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_contacts
description: List the phone's contacts. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_notify_list
description: List the notifications currently on the phone, from any app. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_location
description: Get the phone's location. provider is gps, network or passive. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_camera_photo
description: Take a photo with the back camera (camera 0, the default; the front selfie camera is 1) and save it as images/<name>.jpg. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_mic_record
description: Record from the phone microphone for a number of seconds, from 1 to 60, into audio/<name>.m4a. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_clipboard_get
description: Read what is on the phone's clipboard. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: phone_wallpaper
description: Set an image from the workspace as the phone wallpaper. Needs the user's approval in the dashboard each time.

name: photo_cinematic
description: Give a photo a cinematic look and show the result. style is teal-orange, noir or warm-film. letterbox adds widescreen black bars. Saves images/<name>.png.

name: multi_run_sequential
description: Run up to 10 tool calls one after another, in order. calls is a JSON list of {"tool": name, "arguments": {...}}. With stop_on_error true, the rest are skipped after the first error.

name: multi_run_pipeline
description: Run up to 10 tool calls in order, where the text {prev} inside an argument is replaced by the previous call's result (first 2000 characters). Stops at the first error.

name: multi_run_with_retry
description: Run up to 10 tool calls in parallel. A call that returns an error is tried again up to retries times (max 5).

name: multi_run_with_timeout
description: Run up to 10 tool calls in parallel and give up on any that take longer than timeout_s seconds (max 60).

name: job_start
description: Start a tool in the background and return a job id at once. Check it with job_status and job_result. At most 10 jobs run at a time.

name: job_status
description: Show whether a background job is running, done, failed or cancelled.

name: job_result
description: Get the result of a finished background job.

name: job_cancel
description: Stop waiting for a background job. Its result is thrown away; work already in progress may still finish.

name: job_list
description: List background jobs and their states.

name: tool_search_local
description: Search tool names and descriptions for a word, to find the right tool.

name: tool_describe
description: Show one tool's full description and its parameters.

name: tool_groups
description: Show the tool groups (the first word of each tool name), how many tools each has, and whether it is switched off.

name: tool_disable_group
description: Hide a whole group of tools (for example phone or video) so Claude's tool list is shorter. Resets when the server restarts.

name: tool_enable_group
description: Switch a hidden tool group back on.

name: tool_usage_stats
description: Show which tools have been used the most, from the activity log.

name: tool_dry_run
description: Check a tool call without running it: unknown tool, missing or unknown arguments, and whether it needs approval.

name: server_health
description: Show uptime, tool count, open sessions, pending approvals, log size and disk space.

name: secrets_scan
description: Look through workspace text files for things that look like keys, tokens or passwords. Shows file, line and kind only, never the value.

name: audit_log_verify
description: Check the activity log for damaged lines and show its size and time range.

name: rotate_api_key
description: Replace the default connection's API key with a new one. Needs the user's approval. The new key is saved to the key file and is not shown, so update the connector afterwards.

name: workspace_snapshot
description: Zip the whole workspace into the server's snapshot folder (outside the workspace) so it can be restored later. Refuses over 300 MB.

name: workspace_restore
description: Put files from a snapshot back into the workspace, overwriting files with the same path. Needs the user's approval.

name: undo_last_write
description: Put a file back to how it was before its last write_file, text_replace or append_file.

name: trash_file
description: Move a file to the trash instead of deleting it. Can be undone with restore_from_trash. No approval needed.

name: restore_from_trash
description: List trashed files (empty name) or put one back where it came from.

name: empty_trash
description: Permanently delete everything in the trash. Needs the user's approval.

name: permission_report
description: Summarise who can connect, which connections are trusted, which tools need approval, and what is pending.

name: regex_search
description: Search workspace text files with a regular expression. Shows file, line number and the line.

name: regex_replace
description: Replace text matching a regular expression in one file. Only counts the matches unless apply is true; applying saves an undo copy first.

name: apply_patch
description: Apply several exact text edits to one file all-or-nothing. edits is a JSON list of {"old": "...", "new": "..."}; each old text must appear exactly once.

name: line_edit
description: Replace lines start to end (1-based, inclusive) of a file with new_text.

name: insert_lines
description: Insert text after a line number (0 puts it at the top).

name: delete_lines
description: Delete lines start to end (1-based, inclusive) from a file.

name: python_syntax_check
description: Check a Python file for syntax errors without running it. No approval needed.

name: html_validate
description: Check an HTML file for unclosed or stray tags.

name: code_outline
description: List the functions, classes and constants in a .py, .js or .css file with their line numbers.

name: todo_scan
description: Find TODO, FIXME and HACK notes in workspace text files.

name: markdown_toc
description: Make a table of contents from a Markdown file's headings.

name: json_get
description: Read one value from a JSON file using a dotted path such as users.0.name. Empty key_path shows the whole file.

name: json_set
description: Set one value in a JSON file using a dotted path. value is parsed as JSON, or kept as text if it is not valid JSON.

name: json_merge
description: Merge the JSON object in other_path into the one in path (nested objects merge, other values are replaced).

name: csv_stats
description: Summarise each column of a CSV: counts, and min, max and mean for number columns.

name: csv_filter
description: Keep the CSV rows where a column matches, and save them as data/<name>.csv. mode is equals, contains, gt or lt (gt and lt compare numbers).

name: csv_sort
description: Sort a CSV by one column (numbers sort as numbers) and save it as data/<name>.csv.

name: sqlite_query
description: Run a read-only SELECT on a SQLite database in the workspace. Nothing can be changed.

name: sqlite_execute
description: Run a SQL statement that changes a SQLite database (insert, update, create, delete). Needs the user's approval, who sees the exact SQL.

name: xml_to_json
description: Convert an XML file into JSON saved as data/<name>.json.

name: csv_to_svg_chart
description: Draw a simple bar chart (first 30 rows) from two CSV columns as charts/<name>.svg.

name: http_request
description: Make an HTTP request to a public address. GET and HEAD run at once. POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE need the user's approval. Returns the status, some headers and the first 4000 characters of the body.

name: rss_read
description: Read an RSS or Atom feed and list its newest items with title, date and link.

name: sitemap_urls_all
description: List page addresses from a site's sitemap.xml, following sitemap index files (up to 3 levels).

name: page_to_markdown
description: Turn a public web page into Markdown saved as docs/<name>.md.

name: extract_tables
description: Save every table on a public page as data/<name>-1.csv, data/<name>-2.csv and so on (first 10 tables).

name: download_many
description: Download several public files (one address per line, up to 10, each up to 100 MB) into a workspace folder. Needs the user's approval once for the whole list unless the connection is trusted.

name: api_json_fetch
description: Fetch JSON from a public API (GET) and optionally pick one value with a dotted path such as data.items.0.name.

name: url_expand
description: Follow a short link's redirects and show where it ends up, without downloading the page.

name: url_status_bulk
description: Check the HTTP status of up to 20 public addresses (one per line) at the same time.

name: site_snapshot
description: Save one public page's HTML, readable text and response headers into projects/experimental/<name>/ for later reference.

name: browser_goto
description: Go to another public address inside an open browser session.

name: browser_back
description: Go back one page in a browser session.

name: browser_reload
description: Reload the current page in a browser session.

name: browser_run_js
description: Run a JavaScript expression in the page and return its result. Needs the user's approval each time, who sees the exact code.

name: browser_get_element_text
description: Return the text of one element, found by CSS selector or visible text.

name: browser_find_all
description: List clickable things on the page whose text contains the given words, with the pixel position of each centre. Use the position with browser_click_xy when a normal click picks the wrong element.

name: browser_click_xy
description: Click the exact pixel (x, y) of the page with a real mouse click, for buttons a text click misses. Clicks on things that look like login, submit, accept, pay or approve need the user's approval, as with browser_click.

name: browser_pixel_grid
description: Take a screenshot with a labelled pixel grid drawn on top, so you can read off coordinates for browser_click_xy. Saves screenshots/<name>.png.

name: browser_wait_idle
description: Wait until the page has stopped loading and no new network requests arrive for one second.

name: browser_emulate_device
description: Make a browser session look like a phone, tablet or desktop: size, touch and user agent. device is iphone, android, ipad or desktop.

name: pdf_info
description: Show a PDF's page count, title and size (uses pdfinfo; install with: pkg install poppler).

name: pdf_extract_text
description: Read the text of a PDF (uses pdftotext). last_page 0 means to the end.

name: pdf_to_images
description: Turn PDF pages into PNG images in images/<name>-N.png (at most 10 pages, uses pdftoppm).

name: pdf_merge
description: Join several PDFs (comma-separated workspace paths, in order) into pdfs/<name>.pdf (uses pdfunite).

name: image_crop
description: Cut a rectangle out of an image (x, y is the top-left corner) into images/<name>.png.

name: image_rotate
description: Rotate an image by 90, 180 or 270 degrees into images/<name>.png.

name: image_compress
description: Make a smaller JPG copy of an image. quality is 1 (smallest) to 100 (best). Saves images/<name>.jpg.

name: image_filter
description: Apply an effect to an image into images/<name>.png. effect is grayscale, blur, sharpen, invert or sepia.

name: image_contact_sheet
description: Put all the images of one type in a folder onto one sheet of thumbnails, saved as images/<name>.png.

name: audio_concat
description: Join several audio files (comma-separated workspace paths, in order) into audio/<name>.mp3.

name: phone_dialog_confirm
description: Show a Yes/No pop-up on the phone and return what the user chose. Use it to ask the user in person (Termux:API).

name: phone_dialog_text
description: Ask the user to type an answer in a pop-up on the phone and return it (Termux:API).

name: phone_fingerprint_check
description: Ask for a fingerprint on the phone and report success or failure (Termux:API). Does not approve anything by itself.

name: phone_notify_buttons
description: Send a notification with one or two buttons. The buttons show a short toast when pressed (Termux:API).

name: phone_storage_info
description: Show free and total storage on the phone's home folder.

name: phone_share_file
description: Open the phone's share sheet for a workspace file, so the user can send it to an app. Needs the user's approval each time.

name: git_status
description: Show the git status of the workspace (changed and new files).

name: git_diff
description: Show uncommitted changes in the workspace, or in one file.

name: git_commit
description: Stage everything in the workspace and commit it with a message. Needs the user's approval.

name: note_add
description: Add a dated note to notes.md in the workspace.

name: task_add
description: Add a checkbox task to tasks.md in the workspace. due is optional, for example 2026-12-01.

name: project_template
description: Create a starter web project in projects/<name>. kind is blank, landing or portfolio. Refuses if the project already exists.
